cases.invariant: Interrupted saves must not destroy the previous commit.
Partial staging leaves committed data reloadable.
A failed write remains unpublished and preserves the previous commit.
Staging is invisible; committed data survives a missing acknowledgement.
Two accepted appends must not lose one operation.
Reject stale publication, then rebase from current state before a bounded retry.
A stale cleanup list must not delete the now-current generation.
Revalidate and delete within one protected operation.
Protect active readers/writers; deletion failures retain garbage without losing current data.
Preserve values across migration and reject stale old-format writers.
Unknown or invalid formats fail without overwriting stored bytes.
